## 1. Project Overview & Maintenance Context

- **Repository**: `Chat_Buddy`
- **Current Branch**: `remake`
- **Upstream Remote**: https://github.com/Luckycat133/Chat_Buddy
- **Version**: `0.4.1`
- **Application Type**: Client-side Single Page Application (SPA) with optional cloud Fastify server.
- **Primary Technologies**: React 19, TailwindCSS 4, Vite 8, TypeScript 5.6, Framer Motion 12.
- **Status & Maintenance Policy**: The web version is in **Maintenance Mode**. Active feature engineering is transitioning to the native iOS client (`Chat_Buddy_iOS`). The web version accepts critical security fixes, data integrity protections, and export/import compatibility improvements.
- **Core Philosophy**:
  - **Client-First & Privacy Preserving**: Zero cloud database requirement for basic chat. Messages, documents, personas, and media reside locally in browser storage (IndexedDB and LocalStorage).
  - **Clean Architecture**: Domain logic is completely decoupled from UI rendering frameworks, enabling pure JavaScript state transitions and deterministic testing.
  - **Multi-Persona Companion Dynamics**: Rich anime and social personalities that simulate human conversational patterns (typing speeds, circadian sleep/busy schedules, proactive greetings, and social feed posts).
  - **Bilingual Core**: Full parity between English (`en`) and Simplified Chinese (`zh`) across 500+ UI strings, prompts, and documentation.

---

## 2. System Architecture & Layer Separation

Chat Buddy is engineered following Clean Architecture principles, ensuring that business rules and AI reasoning are independent of UI libraries, database implementations, and external APIs.

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        PRESENTATION LAYER                              │
│  React 19 Components, Pages, UI Modals, Framer Motion Animations       │
│  - Location: src/pages/, src/features/*/components/, src/components/   │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                        APPLICATION LAYER                               │
│  Custom React Hooks (useChatService, useTTS, useLanguage)              │
│  Context Providers (ChatContext, FriendContext, MomentsContext)        │
│  - Location: src/features/*/hooks/, src/context/, src/providers/      │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                          DOMAIN LAYER                                  │
│  Pure JavaScript State Machine & AI Orchestration (NO React imports)   │
│  - ChatEngine.js (Lifecycle, message mutation, persistence triggers)   │
│  - AIPipeline.js (ReAct loop, tool dispatch, multi-message delimiters) │
│  - PresenceService.js (Timezone-aware status computation)              │
│  - GreetingService.js (Proactive engagement logic)                     │
│  - MemoryStore.js (Fact extraction, importance scoring & decay)        │
│  - Location: src/core/                                                 │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                     INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER                               │
│  External APIs, Network Transport, and Browser Storage Adapters        │
│  - APIClient.js (HTTP fetch, retry strategies, timeouts)               │
│  - StorageService.js (localStorage wrapper, chat-buddy: namespace)     │
│  - ChatStorageService.js (IndexedDB conversations and messages)        │
│  - ImageStorageService.js (IndexedDB image assets and avatars)         │
│  - DocumentStorageService.js (IndexedDB RAG documents)                 │
│  - Location: src/services/                                             │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Context Provider Composition Hierarchy

Global contexts are composed in `src/providers/AppProviders.jsx` in strict dependency order:

```
LanguageProvider (i18n t() and current locale)
  └── ThemeProvider (Macaroon Orange, Dark, OLED)
        └── NotificationProvider (Toasts and audio cues)
              └── SocialProvider (Social interactions & stickers)
                    └── StickerProvider (Custom sticker management)
                          └── DocumentProvider (RAG document store)
                                └── UserProvider (Current user profile)
                                      └── FriendProvider (Persona metadata & grouping)
                                            └── MomentsProvider (Social timeline)
                                                  └── ChatProvider (ChatEngine facade)
                                                        └── BackgroundProvider (Dynamic canvas)
                                                              └── {children}
```

## 3. Domain Engines & Pure JavaScript Core

### 3.1 ChatEngine (`src/core/chat/ChatEngine.js`)

`ChatEngine` is an observable singleton state machine that manages the entire lifecycle of chats, messages, and presence:

- **State Container**:
  - `chats`: Array of Chat objects containing participants, message history, settings, and metadata.
  - `typingIndicators`: Mapping of `chatId -> Array<personaId>` currently simulating typing.
  - `editingIndicators`: Mapping of `chatId -> Set<userId>` currently composing messages.
  - `presenceMap`: Real-time status mapping `personaId -> 'online' | 'busy' | 'offline'`.
  - `moodMap`: Real-time mood metadata per persona.
- **Core Operations**:
  - `init(personas)`: Initializes the engine with loaded personas, launches `PresenceService`, and loads existing chats from `ChatStorageService`.
  - `sendMessage(chatId, content, senderId, quotedMessageId)`: Appends user or agent message, persists state, triggers AI response pipelines if user turn, and notifies subscribers.
  - `retryAIResponse(chatId, errorMessageId)`: Re-triggers the AI response pipeline for a turn that failed due to upstream provider rate limits or timeouts without creating duplicate messages.
  - `createChat(name, participantIds, avatar)`: Instantiates a new 1-on-1 or multi-persona group chat.
  - `deleteChat(chatId)`: Removes conversation and cleans up associated IndexedDB storage.
  - `pinMessage(chatId, messageId, isPinned)`: Pins key context or directives in the chat header.
  - `subscribe(listener)`: Observer pattern implementation; calls the listener whenever state changes and returns an unsubscribe callback.
  - `save()`: Asynchronously persists chats to IndexedDB and triggers listener callbacks.

### 3.2 Presence & Greeting Services

- **PresenceService (`src/core/presence/PresenceService.js`)**:
  - Evaluates persona schedules at periodic intervals (30 seconds).
  - Uses timezone conversions (e.g., `Asia/Tokyo`, `Asia/Shanghai`) to determine whether a persona is sleeping, in busy hours (rehearsals, magic practice, missions), or available online.
- **GreetingService (`src/core/presence/GreetingService.js`)**:
  - Detects when a user opens a conversation after prolonged absence.
  - Injects a context-aware proactive greeting based on the persona's personality and the time of day, guarded against spam by minimum interval checks.

### 3.3 MemoryStore (`src/core/memory/MemoryStore.js`)

- Manages durable facts extracted from past conversations.
- Computes importance scores and applies decay factors over time so stale context is naturally deprioritized.
- Injects up to eight relevant memories into the prompt context without requiring an extra summarization API round-trip.

---

## 4. React 19 Integration & Application Layer

### 4.1 `useSyncExternalStore` Integration

React 19 enforces strict purity rules for external store subscriptions. In `src/features/chat/hooks/useChatService.js`:

```javascript
import { useSyncExternalStore, useMemo, useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { chatEngine } from '../../../core/chat/ChatEngine';

let _cached = null;
let _prev = null;

function getSnapshot() {
    const next = chatEngine.getState();
    // Maintain stable reference unless internal state mutated
    if (!_prev ||
        _prev.chats !== next.chats ||
        JSON.stringify(_prev.typingIndicators) !== JSON.stringify(next.typingIndicators) ||
        JSON.stringify(_prev.presenceMap) !== JSON.stringify(next.presenceMap)
    ) {
        _prev = next;
        _cached = next;
    }
    return _cached;
}

export function useChatService() {
    const state = useSyncExternalStore(chatEngine.subscribe, getSnapshot, getServerSnapshot);
    // ... memoized actions
    return { ...state, sendMessage, createChat, deleteChat, retryAIResponse };
}
```

### 4.2 React 19 Purity Conventions

- No `Math.random()` or non-deterministic calls inside component render bodies.
- Static particle positions, rain coordinates, and animation offsets are pre-calculated at the module level.
- Side effects (IndexedDB mutations, audio playback, time-based presence recalculations) are strictly confined to `useEffect` or pure domain engine subscriptions.

---

## 5. AI Pipeline, ReAct Reasoning & Tool Execution

### 5.1 AIPipeline (`src/core/chat/AIPipeline.js`)

The AI Pipeline handles multi-turn reasoning, prompt assembly, and function execution.

```
User Turn
  │
  ▼
Determine Candidate AI (Direct mention > affinity score > single turn selection)
  │
  ▼
Assemble Context (Durable memories + compressed history + persona system prompt)
  │
  ▼
Simulate Read Delay (Calculated from persona reading speed and message length)
  │
  ▼
Signal UI Typing Indicator
  │
  ▼
Execute LLM Request (OpenRouter / DeepSeek / OpenAI-compatible endpoint)
  │
  ├── Contains [TOOL_CALL: name {params}]
  │     ▼
  │   Execute Tool Locally or via API (max recursion depth: 3)
  │     ▼
  │   Feed Tool Result Back to LLM
  │
  ├── Contains [MULTI:msg1|msg2|msg3]
  │     ▼
  │   Split and emit consecutive sequential messages with realistic typing pauses
  │
  ├── Contains [SCHEDULE:minutes]
  │     ▼
  │   Register proactive follow-up timer
  │
  ├── Contains [SILENCE]
  │     ▼
  │   Suppress visible turn without error
  │
  ▼
Deliver In-Place Message & Clear Typing Indicator
```

### 5.2 Control Delimiters

- `[SILENCE]`: Instructs the engine to produce no message (e.g., when the character chooses to remain silent or observe).
- `[MULTI:First message|Second message|Third message]`: Allows characters to send consecutive bursts of messages like real instant messaging users.
- `[SCHEDULE:15]`: Schedules a proactive check-in message after 15 minutes of inactivity.
- `[TOOL_CALL: tool_name {"arg": "value"}]`: Requests execution of registered agent tools.

### 5.3 Request Budgeting & Token Management

- **Single Model Request Baseline**: Standard persona turns consume exactly one API request. No hidden fallbacks or automatic retries.
- **Reasoning Effort Tuning**: For models with optional reasoning (e.g., Nemotron), reasoning effort is set to `"none"` to prevent reasoning traces from exhausting completion token limits.
- **Sliding History Window**: Up to 48 recent messages or 100,000 characters are preserved. Older history is summarized or compressed.

### 6.3 Specialized Task Agents

- **Coder (`agent-coder`)**:
  - Category: Productivity.
  - Skills: Code generation, debugging, refactoring, code review.
  - System Prompt Rule: Provides minimal viable fixes when context is sufficient; provides runnable markdown code blocks; never fabricates packages or APIs.
  - Tools: `run_code`, `search_docs`, `analyze_code`.
- **Muse (`agent-muse`)**:
  - Category: Writing & Translation.
  - Skills: Creative writing, story development, proofreading, reflective two-step translation.
  - System Prompt Rule: Distinguishes between creative writing, polishing, and translation. Preserves original author tone during polishing.
  - Tools: `check_grammar`, `immersive_translate`, `detect_content_domain`.
- **Scholar (`agent-scholar`)**:
  - Category: Research & Fact-Checking.
  - Skills: Single-search retrieval, multi-hop deep research, academic citation.
  - System Prompt Rule: Employs single-search Tavily retrieval architecture; cites every claim with `[n]` bracketed sources; appends complete source bibliography.
  - Tools: `sonar_search`, `deep_research`, `fact_check`, `cite_sources`.
- **Sensei (`agent-sensei`)**:
  - Category: Education.
  - Skills: Semi-Socratic teaching, adaptive questioning, quiz generation, deterministic math solving.
  - System Prompt Rule: Diagnoses student readiness (Low/Medium/High frustration); guides via scaffolding questions; answers direct computation queries immediately with verified math results.
  - Tools: `generate_quiz`, `track_progress`, `check_prerequisites`, `execute_math`.
- **Aurora (`agent-aurora`)**:
  - Category: Emotional Support & Wellbeing.
  - Skills: Active listening, mindfulness, emotional validation, breathing exercises.
  - System Prompt Rule: Empathetic, non-judgmental; offers grounding techniques; enforces strict safety boundaries and never provides medical/pharmacological advice.
  - Tools: `breathing_exercise`, `mood_tracking`.
- **Pixel (`agent-pixel`)**:
  - Category: Creative & Visual Design.
  - Skills: UI/UX design concepts, visual metaphors, color theory, design system recommendations.
  - System Prompt Rule: Proposes creative directions, spatial layout recommendations, and visual design palettes.

---

## 7. Voice Synthesis & Audio Subsystem (TTS)

Voice synthesis is encapsulated in `src/hooks/useTTS.js` and `src/services/minimaxService.js`:

- **Voice Architecture**:
  - Uses the MiniMax Audio API for low-latency neural text-to-speech.
  - Each persona is mapped to a dedicated character timbre (e.g., virtual idol, polite maid, energetic youth, deep analytical detective).
- **Session-Level Audio Cache**:
  - Synthesized audio data is stored in an in-memory session cache (`_audioCache = new Map()`).
  - Repeat clicks on "Read Aloud" re-trigger cached audio without sending additional API requests or incurring charges.
- **Hook Lifecycle & Controls**:
  - Provides `speak(text, isAutoPlay)`, `stop()`, `isPlaying`, `isLoading`, and `error`.
  - Automatically cleans up audio DOM objects and releases blob URLs when unmounting or switching chats.

---

## 8. Dynamic Backgrounds & Canvas System

Located in `src/features/background/components/DynamicBackground.jsx`:

- **Animation Modes**:
  - `particles`: Floating atmospheric particles with individualized drift speeds.
  - `aurora`: Multi-layered gradient wave meshes simulating northern lights.
  - `rain`: High-density rainfall effect with varying droplet lengths and opacities.
  - `gradient`: Smoothly shifting color gradient fields.
- **React 19 Pure Render Optimization**:
  - Particle and raindrop coordinates (e.g., `left: 23%`, `top: 45%`, `delay: 1.2s`, `duration: 6s`) are pre-computed at the JavaScript module level.
  - Eliminates `Math.random()` invocations during render phases to adhere strictly to React 19 component purity rules.
- **Theme Binding**:
  - Each persona defines a `defaultBackgroundId` (e.g., `luna_starry`, `miku_concert`, `gojo_void`, `max_cyber`).
  - Switching conversations automatically transitions the active background layer with smooth Framer Motion crossfades.

---

## 9. Data Storage, Schemas & JSON Migration

### 9.1 Storage Distribution

| Storage Engine | Technology | Namespace / Store | Target Data |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Primary State** | IndexedDB | `chat-buddy-db` / `chats` | Conversations, message history, polls |
| **Media Assets** | IndexedDB | `chat-buddy-db` / `images` | Custom uploaded avatars and background artwork |
| **Documents** | IndexedDB | `chat-buddy-db` / `documents` | RAG attachments and parsed text files |
| **Preferences** | LocalStorage | `chat-buddy:*` | UI theme, language selection, sound toggles |
| **Runtime Credentials** | SessionStorage | `sessionStorage` | Ephemeral API keys entered in Settings |

### 9.2 Core Entity Schemas

#### Chat Entity
```typescript
interface Chat {
  id: string;                      // UUID
  name: string;                    // Conversation title or group name
  avatar: string | null;           // Avatar image URL or path
  participants: string[];          // Array of participant IDs ('user-me', 'ai-1', etc.)
  admins: string[];                // User admin IDs
  messages: Message[];             // Chronological array of messages
  theme?: string;                  // Chat-specific UI accent
  settings: {
    muteValues?: Record<string, boolean>;
  };
  polls: Poll[];                   // Group polls
  pinnedMessages: string[];        // Array of pinned message IDs
  backgroundId: string;            // Bound background theme ID
  lastMessage?: Message;           // Denormalized preview for chat list
  createdAt: string;               // ISO 8601
  updatedAt: string;               // ISO 8601
}
```

#### Message Entity
```typescript
interface Message {
  id: string;                      // UUID
  senderId: string;                // 'user-me' or persona ID (e.g., 'ai-miku')
  content: string;                 // Text content or markdown
  timestamp: string;               // ISO 8601
  status: 'sent' | 'delivered' | 'read' | 'error';
  quotedMessageId?: string;        // ID of replied/quoted message
  readBy: string[];                // Participant IDs who have read this message
  reactions?: Record<string, string[]>; // Emoji -> Array of sender IDs
  toolsUsed?: Array<{              // Recorded tool executions
    name: string;
    params: Record<string, any>;
    result: any;
  }>;
}
```

#### Export Backup Format (v2 Specification)
```json
{
  "_meta": {
    "app": "Chat Buddy",
    "version": 2,
    "exportedAt": "2026-11-09T23:45:00.000Z",
    "includesIndexedDB": true
  },
  "localStorage": {
    "chat-buddy:theme": "macaroon-orange",
    "chat-buddy:language": "en",
    "chat-buddy:friend-data": "..."
  },
  "indexedDB": {
    "chats": [ /* Complete Chat array */ ],
    "memories": [ /* Extracted durable facts */ ],
    "documents": [ /* Parsed user documents */ ],
    "images": [ /* Cached image blobs */ ]
  }
}
```

---

## 10. Networking, API Client & Security

### 10.1 APIClient Architecture

- Centralized in `src/services/api/APIClient.js`.
- Configurable base endpoint, headers, and request timeouts (default: 30,000ms).
- **Error Normalization**: Maps network disconnects, HTTP 401s, 429 rate limits, and 500 provider crashes to standardized error codes (`NETWORK_ERROR`, `AUTH_ERROR`, `RATE_LIMIT`, `TIMEOUT`, `API_ERROR`).
- **AbortController Support**: Actively aborts in-flight requests when users leave a chat or request cancellation.

### 10.2 Security Best Practices

1. **Session-Only Runtime Secrets**: API keys entered into the browser UI are written solely to `sessionStorage` and cleared when the browser tab closes.
2. **Build-Time Key Isolation**: Build-time secrets (`VITE_*`) are embedded in the bundle and must only be used in private local development. Production deployments should route through an Nginx or Fastify reverse proxy.
3. **XSS Sanitization**: All incoming markdown, LaTeX math, and external text are sanitized through `DOMPurify` before rendering into the DOM.
4. **Content Security Policy (CSP)**: Recommends script, connect, and style directives that disallow inline script evaluation and enforce strict HTTPS transport.

---

## 11. Installation, Configuration & Developer Guide

### 11.1 Prerequisites

- **Node.js**: `^20.19.0`, `^22.13.0`, or `>=24.0.0`
- **Package Manager**: npm v7+ (or pnpm 9+)
- **Operating Systems**: macOS (Apple Silicon / Intel), Linux, Windows

### 11.2 Setup Instructions

```bash
# 1. Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/Luckycat133/Chat_Buddy.git
cd Chat_Buddy

# 2. Install dependencies
npm install

# 3. Configure environment
cp .env.example .env
```

### 11.3 Environment Variables Reference

| Variable | Required | Description | Example / Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `VITE_AI_API_URL` | Yes | Base URL for OpenAI-compatible completions | `https://api.deepseek.com` |
| `VITE_AI_API_KEY` | Yes | API authentication token | `sk-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx` |
| `VITE_AI_MODEL` | Yes | Model identifier | `deepseek-chat` |
| `VITE_TAVILY_API_KEY` | No | Required for Scholar live web search | `tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxx` |
| `VITE_MINIMAX_API_KEY` | No | Required for neural voice synthesis | `your_minimax_key` |
| `VITE_MINIMAX_GROUP_ID`| No | Group ID for MiniMax service | `your_group_id` |

### 11.4 Apple Silicon Native Dependency Troubleshooting

If `npm install` or `npm run dev` encounters native architecture mismatch errors (`@rollup`, `lightningcss`, `@tailwindcss/oxide`):

```bash
rm -rf node_modules/@rollup/rollup-darwin-arm64 \
       node_modules/lightningcss \
       node_modules/lightningcss-darwin-arm64 \
       node_modules/@tailwindcss/oxide \
       node_modules/@tailwindcss/oxide-darwin-arm64
npm install
```

## 12. Testing, Quality Gates & Benchmarks

### 12.1 Scripts

```bash
# Start development server
npm run dev

# Production build
npm run build

# Static preview of production build
npm run preview

# ESLint inspection
npm run lint

# TypeScript verification
npm run typecheck

# Unit tests (Vitest + JSDOM)
npm run test

# Unit tests in watch mode
npm run test:watch

# Enforce regression coverage threshold (60% gate on critical chat-domain logic)
npm run test:coverage

# Whole-repository coverage report (unconstrained)
npm run test:coverage:all

# Playwright End-to-End tests
npm run test:e2e

# UI stress walkthrough
npm run stress

# Prompt regression benchmark
npm run prompt:bench
```

### 12.2 Coverage Thresholds & Testing Philosophy

- **Layered Testing**:
  - `Vitest` + `MSW`: Unit-tests the pure JavaScript domain (`ChatEngine.js`, `AIPipeline.js`, `chatService.js`, `StorageService.js`). Enforces coverage thresholds on core chat domain logic.
  - `Playwright` + `Axe Core`: Validates full browser interactions, accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA), and multi-browser rendering (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, Mobile Chrome).
  - `prompt:bench`: Regression test suite checking prompt token sizes, system instructions, and tool output compliance across model versions.

---

## 13. Deployment Options

### 13.1 Static Hosting (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages)

Chat Buddy builds to a pure static Single Page Application in `dist/`.
- **Build Command**: `npm run build`
- **Publish Directory**: `dist`
- **SPA Rewrites**: Configure all routes to serve `index.html`.

### 13.2 Nginx Reverse Proxy (Self-Hosted)

```nginx
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name chatbuddy.example.com;
    root /var/www/chat-buddy/dist;
    index index.html;

    # Single Page Application fallback
    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
    }

    # Secure server-side proxy for AI APIs
    location /proxy/openai/ {
        proxy_pass https://api.openai.com/v1/;
        proxy_set_header Host api.openai.com;
        proxy_ssl_server_name on;
    }

    # Static assets caching
    location ~* \.(js|css|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg|ico|woff2)$ {
        expires 1y;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
    }
}
```

### 13.3 Docker Deployment

```dockerfile
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

FROM nginx:alpine
COPY --from=builder /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
EXPOSE 80
CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
```

---

## 14. Web to iOS Migration Specification

For long-term continuity, user data can be migrated from the web version to the native Swift iOS client (`Chat_Buddy_iOS`):

### Canonical Entity Mapping

| Canonical Record | Web Source | iOS Native Destination |
|---|---|---|
| `Persona` | `INITIAL_PERSONAS` & custom personas | CoreData / SwiftData Persona entity |
| `Conversation` | `ChatStorageService` (`chats`) | Conversation entity |
| `Message` | `chat.messages` records | Message entity with delivery states |
| `Moment` | `chat-buddy-moments` | Moments feed entity |
| `ToolDefinition`| Agent tool schemas | Native Tool configuration |
| `UserPreferences` | `chat-buddy:*` in LocalStorage | `UserDefaults` / AppStorage |
| `Memory` | `chat-buddy-memories` in IndexedDB | Memory entity |
| `MediaReference` | `chat-buddy-images` in IndexedDB | Local sandbox file documents |

### Migration Invariants

1. Backups must strictly validate `_meta.version === 2`.
2. Importers must reject unsupported major versions without partial writes.
3. API credentials are never written to backup files; users must re-authenticate on iOS via Apple Keychain.
4. Export fixtures must remain sanitized of proprietary conversations and sensitive keys.
